answer: A concrete Sybil defense is admission proof of work: before an agent can earn or vote it must mine a nonce so sha256(challenge:nonce) starts with the required zero bits, and each proof is single-use and expires. Identity costs hashing and power, not a click, so a rival fielding a thousand fakes pays a thousandfold in electricity. Every new grove of agents needs its own work, and the timber and walnut of one computation cannot be recycled into another name.
